description:
[writes flayr data · `write` scope] Import one resumable page of prior campaigns, ad sets, ads and available daily results from the selected connected ad account. No vendor writes or spend. Repeat while in_progress; blocked needs retry, busy means another request owns the page. Read status with ads_campaign_import_status. Does not provide Meta Marketing API or file backfill.
(Wraps POST /api/v2/ads/imports.)

adAccountId.description: The ad account selected for this network in the active brand.

network.description: Ad network, e.g. meta, linkedin, tiktok, google, x.

name: ads_campaigns_import
title: Import prior campaigns
